changes.title: Boot phrases
items: The music while the home speakers boot up no longer loops its tune: a new melody every 16 bars

changes.title: Fen
items: A new kind of area, the fen: black peaty pools and sedge under aspen and alder, a sunken punt, and the newt, a new creature with its own sigil, voice and legend's gift (Newt's Wriggle: 💌s fly a little faster and further)
The fen is the first area made from a recipe of data alone

changes.title: Wolf evolution
items: The wolf evolves: a round pup with big paws and floppy ears, a lanky young, an adult with a shaggy mane over its shoulders, and the legend: huge shoulders, a mane of spiky locks with pale spirit-fire rising from its spine, glowing eyes and frost on its muzzle
